notes: Cross-verse split. The accusative αὐτόν has already written the antecedent 'him', so under rule 32's apposition clause — carried to an adjective complement by rule 31 in terms, with αὐτοῖς δὲ τοῖς κλητοῖς → 'unto them that are called' as its example — the article τόν realizes nothing and the predicate adjective τυφλόν carries the supplied relativizer along with the copula. JHN.9.18 and JHN.9.37 already read the identical configuration that way; this verse was the outlier.
